motivation: Input gain adds only0.18349pp over LS on primary speaker validation; LS alone misses SSC practical screen and regresses on ECG100. Test internal activity-dependent threshold conditioning as a distinct mechanism, not another input-gain change.
A: Existing project DTH: bounded per-neuron static threshold plus causal per-sample fast/slow layer-activity terms; rho.9/.99,target.05,bounds.5/1.5,gainszero initially.
B: Existing train-only uniform label smoothing epsilon.1; ordinary hard CE and no smoothing at validation/inference.
hypothesis: Activity-dependent internal excitability can provide information beyond train-only confidence regularization for clean held-out-speaker classification. Complementarity and cross-dataset benefit are unproven.

prior_art.title: Bellec et al., Long short-term memory and learning-to-learn in networks of spiking neurons,2018
prior_art.distinction: Adaptive thresholds are established. Current DTH implementation uses bounded logistic neuron thresholds with per-sample layer fast/slow activity. No claim this combination is novel.

prior_art.title: Szegedy et al., Rethinking the Inception Architecture for Computer Vision,2016
prior_art.distinction: Uniform label smoothing is established. This study tests its interaction with existing project DTH, not novelty of smoothing.

selection_basis: Mechanism contrast and current speaker/SSC/ECG validation evidence; no new official-test inspection and no selection using a historical test-score ranking. Final official-test evidence is reused, not pristine confirmation.
controls: Fresh all four under new source snapshot; prior random-split, augmentation, smaller-batch or speaker-exposed DTH controls are not reused.
advancement_rule: At30, assess DTH-Baseline and combination-DTH; require combination-LS >=0.5pp too before attributing incremental DTH complementarity. Support with ordinary validation CE and stability/curves. Gap shrinkage alone insufficient. Extend entire matched comparison only for improving/inconclusive evidence. No success/significance assumed.
mechanism_followup_if_promising: Separate static-threshold-only control needed before attributing gains specifically to dynamic traces rather than learned static threshold; inspect learned gains/thresholds.
sensitivity_rule: Only shortlist on predeclared6/10pair; fresh own-split weights, no pair/hyperparameter search.
transfer_rule: Only promising candidates progress to calibrated SSC10/40 and ECG50/100screens; no full dual-protocol training for every idea.
estimate_basis: Historical SHD30~8-10minutes/arm at1024; DTH overhead not yet measured, update estimate from disposable realbatch calibration before launch.
